meta.name: malformed-shape
meta.description: Language-neutral expected outcomes for capsules whose ZIP container is well-formed but whose manifest or chain documents violate the required field shapes. Independent implementations MUST refuse these capsules: stage 'open' means the reader rejects the document before verification (by error, exception, or fail-closed result, per the host language's idiom); the default verify stage means the capsule opens but verification reports ok=false. No fixture here may make a verifier raise an unhandled exception.
meta.no_warranty: Conformance fixtures only; not production templates or advice.

reasons.invalid_manifest_shape: manifest.json parses as JSON but a required field is absent or has the wrong type/format (not an object, no content_index, content_index.files not an array, a files[] entry without a 64-char lowercase hex sha256)

notes: The 'reason' field is normative: an implementation must reject the fixture for the named reason category. Exact error strings are implementation-defined.

uppercase-event-hash and chain-event-not-object open successfully — the shape violation is inside chain/events.jsonl, so it surfaces at the verify stage. A verifier that feeds the stored hash to a strict hex decoder without a canonical-form guard, or indexes into a non-object event, raises instead of reporting, which these vectors exist to catch.

manifest-hostile-number carries an unknown manifest member whose value is 1e999 (Infinity after JSON parsing). Unknown members are inside the integrity envelope, so the manifest-hash recompute must run over them — and must report the non-canonicalizable number as a verification failure, never raise.

expected.detail: manifest.json is not a JSON object

vectors.name: uppercase-signer-key-hex
vectors.note: The envelope signer's public_key is uppercased post-seal. It decodes to the same 32 key bytes, and signers[] sits outside the canonical payload, so a lane with a case-insensitive hex decoder still sees a valid signature and reports ok=true — the addendum-A11 differential. Canonical hex is lowercase on every hashed or signed surface: verifiers MUST treat a non-canonical signer key as an invalid signature (fail-closed, never an exception).

expected.error_includes: event is not a JSON object
